mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, I.ORDER_ITEM_ID, I.ORDER_ITEM_PRICE, I.ORDER_ITEM_QTY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.IMAGE_SAVED_NAME FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM I ON O.ORDER_ID = I.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ORDER_STATUS = 'READY'

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.MEMBER_ID, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, O.ORDER_CREATED_AT, O.PAID_AT, O.SHIPPING_STARTED_AT, O.EXPECTED_DELIVERED_AT, O.SHIPPED_AT, O.CONFIRMED_AT, I.ORDER_ITEM_ID, I.PRODUCT_ID, I.ORDER_ITEM_PRICE, I.ORDER_ITEM_QTY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PI.IMAGE_SAVED_NAME, CASE WHEN R.REVIEW_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_review FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM I ON O.ORDER_ID = I.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON I.ORDER_ITEM_ID = R.ORDER_ITEM_ID WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND O.ORDER_CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY O.ORDER_CREATED_AT DESC
